{{Quote|The Empire has a legion of loyal soldiers that are in endless supply.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial stormtroopers''', also known simply as '''stormtroopers''', were the elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], stormtroopers served as ever-present reminders of the absolute power of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and would remain an icon of Imperial war efforts for over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] following his death. These faceless enforcers of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] were considered an extension of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] will, and often used efficient yet brutal tactics to keep thousands of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in submission to the Empire. At the height of the Empire, stormtroopers had effectively become symbols of major authority. With few exceptions, they were distinguished from all other [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] units by their signature [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].

The Imperial stormtroopers were the evolution of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. By the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the Galactic Empire. As a result, the Grand Army was reformed into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were renamed "stormtroopers". Under the Empire, stormtroopers operated alongside Imperial [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] units, and some were stationed on Naval [[Starship/Legends|ships]] where they served as marines. Although the Corps was overseen by [[Stormtrooper Command/Legends|Stormtrooper Command]], a military agency that was independent from [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]], all stormtroopers ultimately answered to Emperor Palpatine, and then to [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], with unconditional loyalty and subservience.

Members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] had several slang names for stormtroopers, including "whitehats", "plastic soldiers", "snowmen", "The Boys in White", "bucketheads", "plastic boys", "egg heads". Another term was "Stormies", often used by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].

Although the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of both Emperor Palpatine and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] caused the collapse and fragmentation of the Galactic Empire into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and later the [[Fel Empire]], stormtroopers were also retained as elite soldiers under several successor states such as the [[Empire of the Hand]]. By the year [[138 ABY]], stormtroopers still existed under the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]] and his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]], and the "[[Empire-in-exile]]" of the exiled Galactic Emperor [[Roan Fel]]. By this period, many had come to consider them the personification of war.

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|The clone troopers, now proudly bearing the honorable rank of Imperial stormtroopers, have tackled the dangerous work of fighting our enemies on the front lines. Many have died in their devotion to the Empire. Imperial citizens would do well to remember their example.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Declaration of a New Order]]|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
[[File:BattleofKashyyyk-ImperialEra.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The first stormtroopers were clone troopers of the Galactic Republic.]]
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] reached its end, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] veterans that defended the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] emerged as the feared enforcers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]]. When Emperor Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] the formation of the first Galactic Empire, the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the late [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] were rechristened as '''Imperial stormtroopers'''. Without the guidance of their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|officers]], stormtroopers were "cut loose" to brutally enforce the new Imperial doctrine, to which they quickly built a reputation as merciless, uncompromising soldiers indoctrinated with unconditional loyalty to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

At first, the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] was composed almost entirely of [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]] based on the [[Clone template/Legends|Fett template]].<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> That included the remaining clones that were engineered on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], supplemented by the millions of clones created on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]] through [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti technology]],<ref name="Order66novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and three new stormtrooper clone batches grown in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During this time, traces of the clones' [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|obsolete armor]] remained in the design of their [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|new and improved armor]]. However, the stormtrooper ranks would cease to be dominated by Fett's progeny after the [[Kamino uprising|Battle of Kamino]] in [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]].<ref name="BF2" />

[[File:Kaminouprising.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Kamino uprising caused clones of Jango Fett to become a minority within the wider Stormtrooper Corps.]]
Among the first battles that cemented the stormtroopers' image as elite soldiers to be feared, [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was a planet that was twice made an example of in order to showcase Imperial brutality to anyone else who contemplated defiance against the Empire. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] participated in both the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|first]]<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> and [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|second]] invasion of Kashyyyk,<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> personally leading a contingent of clone stormtroopers to subjugate the planet's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population, as well as to hunt down fugitive members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="DL" /><ref name="TFUvg" /> [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]], the commanding officer of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and one of the first stormtroopers, was slain by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Roan Shryne]] during the Empire's first attack on Kashyyyk.<ref name="DL" />

===The Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|In the past, we secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two. They kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared. But these Rebels were different. They were organized, they were growing, and they were everywhere.|[[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Retired clone trooper|stormtrooper]], commenting on the increasing threat of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]|<ref name="BF2" />}}
[[File:ImperialTrooper-AoD.png|thumb|left|200px|Imperial Stormtroopers were the primary enforcers of the Galactic Empire.]]
By the time the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] began in earnest, Jango Fett's clones were heavily supplanted by clones based on a variety of templates around [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="BF2" /> followed shortly after by enlisted [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="TFUIIvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> Thus, the Fett clones were ironically reduced to a minority status after years of virtually filling the stormtrooper ranks in its entirety. According to a stormtrooper's entry log in the 501st Journal, none of the Fett clones were ever truly able to come to terms with serving alongside recruits and different clones, all of whom were disdainfully dubbed as the "new guys."<ref name="BF2" /> [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], a first generation clone of Jango Fett and a veteran of the Clone Wars, found stormtrooper recruits to be absolutely intolerable. Due to the significant decrease in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] operational effectiveness and his own feelings of nostalgia over the Republic's "[[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army of one man]]," Cody viewed enlisted troopers as incompetent idiots, all of whom he would have gladly sacrificed for just one real clone trooper.<ref name="TFUIIvg" />

[[File:VaderTantive4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers of the 501st Legion escort Darth Vader aboard the rebel controlled ''Tantive IV''.]]
Despite the influx of new troopers from various sources, the ranks remained dominated by Human [[Gender/Legends|males]], thus reflecting the [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]]. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], roughly one-third of the stormtroopers were clones based on the Fett template, while recruits steadily became the majority within the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 96">[[Star Wars Insider 96|''Star Wars Insider'' 96]]</ref> Service in the Stormtrooper Corps was open to both Human men and women, but female stormtroopers were an extremely rare sight under Palpatine's reign and on average there were never more than three female stormtroopers within a whole [[Legion/Legends|legion]].<ref name="EGW" /><ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> In spite of this disparity, some female troopers served in elite units, such as the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].<ref name="RGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Female stormtroopers underwent the same hard training as their male counterparts. Only the best of the best recruits were selected for the stormtrooper corps. Once accepted into the stormtrooper corps, every trooper was treated as an equal. There were no differences between males and females. They even shared the same barracks. Wearing the exact same white [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], one could not distinguish between a male or female stormtrooper.<ref name="EGW" />

[[File:Imperial-formation.png|thumb|left|300px|Imperial stormtroopers in formation aboard Death Star II before the Battle of Endor.]]
For twenty-three years, the stormtroopers suffered few known large scale defeats, at least until the Empire's catastrophic defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. An entire legion of stormtroopers, supported by [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] suffered a humiliating loss that was almost completely unforeseeable, given all of the advantages that the Empire had both in space and on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Despite superior numbers, advanced weapons and superb training, the stormtroopers were utterly defeated by a small infiltration team of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which was greatly assisted by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], small and seemingly insignificant natives indigenous to Endor that Palpatine naturally overlooked as less than a minor threat. This was a devastating mistake which cost the Empire nothing less than its once unbreakable grip on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[File:VictoryOnEndor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Stormtroopers suffered their most embarrassing defeat during the Battle of Endor, where they were overwhelmed by the local Ewoks.]]
The stormtroopers were caught completely by surprise; in their arrogance, they began to break rank and divide into small groups to hunt down the Ewoks. But with no apparent way to counter the variety of guerrilla tactics employed by the Ewoks, the stormtroopers were systematically wiped out by their seemingly inferior opponents. In addition to this strategy, it was a commandeered AT-ST that helped turn the tide and bring the troopers on the defensive, not only dealing a severe blow to the shocked Empire, but also to the reputation of the stormtroopers as well. The news about the defeat of the mighty Imperial stormtroopers against a small band of Rebels and a highly primitive race on a backwater forest moon, combined with the deaths of both Emperor Palpatine and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], galvanized numerous worlds to full-scale rebellion against the Empire's dictatorial rule.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Mara_Fighting_Stormies.png|thumb|left|200px|Stormtroopers under the command of Grand Admiral Thrawn attempt to combat Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and former Emperor's Hand Mara Jade.]]
Many attempts to turn the war back in the Empire's favor ultimately ended with failure. The renowned [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] recovered several [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s to build a new army of clone stormtroopers.<ref name="HeirEmpire" /> Yet due to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer's]] untimely death, the stormtroopers were unable to destroy the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] without Thrawn's guidance.<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> Even the several rebirths of Emperor Palpatine, an accomplishment that he achieved by transferring his essence into various clone bodies of himself in turn, failed to bring the Empire to full restoration.<ref name="DarkEmpire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref><ref name="EmpiresEnd">''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]''</ref> Throughout all of that time, the stormtroopers suffered a series of catastrophic defeats that inflicted a heavy strain on their numbers. As the casualty rates increased substantially, the Stormtrooper Corps was almost all but a memory by [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] as their ranks dwindled from attrition and even desertion.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

[[File:StormtrooperInsertion-TSS.jpg|thumb||right|200px|Stormtroopers being inserted onto the battlefield with AT-ST support.]]
As the war entered its last phase, the former Galactic Empire was reduced to a small collection of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], otherwise known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The Remnant continued to employ stormtroopers in battle until the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]] was signed in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], thus ending the Galactic Civil War with the Empire's surrender. Despite the high level of casualties sustained throughout the war, the Stormtrooper Corps ultimately survived under the Imperial Remnant and other successor states of the fallen Empire, albeit as a broken shadow of its former glory. Following the treaty, stormtroopers were reduced to guard and police functions on the few thousand worlds that remained under Imperial control.<ref name="SpecterPast">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> However, some stormtroopers fought as elite soldiers under the short-lived [[Second Imperium]], an Imperial faction that sought to restore the glory of the first Galactic Empire.<ref name="ShadowAcademy" />

===Post-Galactic Empire period===
{{Quote|And you accept nonhumans into your ranks?''"<br />"''As long as your world is a member of the Empire of the Hand, you're eligible.|[[Su-mil]] and [[Jorm Whistler Mackenni|Twister]], regarding the new Imperial recruiting policy|<ref name="Fool's Bargain">''[[Fool's Bargain]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ShadowStormies-HBCE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow stormtroopers]] trained by [[Carnor Jax]] as his personal guard]]
Although heavily reduced under the Imperial Remnant, stormtroopers retained much of their former duties under the [[Empire of the Hand]], another successor-state to the Galactic Empire that was founded by Grand Admiral Thrawn.<ref name="SpecterPast" /> In addition to protecting the Hand's member worlds, the stormtroopers were ironically used as a liberating force to convince other planetary governments to join the Hand's confederation on their own volition, as opposed to utilizing the former Empire's common strategy of coercion and conquest.<ref name="SQ" /> Though the Empire of the Hand failed to achieve the same kind of longevity as the Imperial Remnant, stormtroopers continued to retain their services under the Remnant, which itself had begun adopting many of the Hand's political and military reforms.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The stormtroopers were eventually restored to their former role as an elite military force when the Imperial Remnant entered the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] on the side of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the successor state to the former New Republic, against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders. They served on various fronts and fought alongside their former enemies, Alliance and [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] alike, until achieving a [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|decisive victory]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself.<ref name="UnifyingForce">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

[[File:Gavrisompellaeon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers were present at the signing of the Pellaeon-Gavrisom Treaty which ended the war between the Imperial Remnant and the New Republic.]]
While the Imperial Remnant slowly regained its former strength, many of the ideals of Palpatine's New Order, such as Human supremacy and alien inferiority, began to die with him. Ultimately, it was necessity that forced the Remnant to loosen its restrictions against Non-Human species, especially since those policies had been some of the primary motivations behind the growth and success of the Rebel Alliance. Without the extensive resources and the unlimited manpower that the Galactic Empire enjoyed in its prime, and with most of the galaxy under the Galactic Alliance's control, the Imperial Remnant had to make do with the few resources it had left, and that entailed allowing aliens and Human females to serve as stormtroopers.<ref name="CSWE" />

As the ranks of the Stormtrooper Corps were steadily replenished with enlisted troopers from both Human and Non-Human sources alike, the Empire's once heavy reliance on clones diminished over time, mainly due to the loss of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and other various worlds that held cloning facilities.<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In addition to the highly expensive operation of consistently producing clone soldiers, the practice was complicated by two other reasons&mdash;the most effective clones that were grown in the Kaminoan-fashion took too long to reach full maturity and the fast-grown Spaarti clones were of extremely poor quality.<ref name="JediVsSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

[[File:Stormtrooper_alt_card_art_IACS.png|thumb|left|250px|Stormtroopers would participate in several conflicts as allies to the Galactic Alliance from the Yuuzhan Vong War through the Second Galactic Civil War.]]
Thus, the Remnant had no choice other than to rely on the patriotism and training of recruits rather than the programmed loyalty and fighting skills of clones. The decrease in the military's operational efficiency was partially compensated by a brutal training regimen that emphasized the stormtroopers' lack of individuality and total dedication to the ideals of the Galactic Empire. The gamble ultimately paid off as the stormtroopers were restored to fighting trim by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Remnant's stormtroopers were excellent marksmen compared to the original stormtroopers of the old Empire.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> The [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]], elite soldiers within the [[Imperial Elite Guard]], were said to be just as effective as Darth Vader's 501st Legion.<ref name="Revelation" /> Until the end of the war, the stormtroopers of the Imperial Remnant fought once more as the allies of the Galactic Alliance, by then under the control of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]].<ref name="Invincible" />

===A divided Empire===
{{Quote|I am, by right of birth and choice, your true Emperor! Not this Sith usurper Krayt! It is to me that you owe your allegiance! I call upon you, my loyal stormtroopers, to join with me and take back our Empire which you have so long and faithfully served.|Roan Fel, demanding the loyalty of Bastion's stormtrooper garrison|<ref name="Legacy 3" />}}
[[File:SWLEG4-FC.jpg|thumb|200px|Imperial stormtroopers fighting for the Sith Empire.]]
By the year [[130 ABY]], stormtroopers were serving as the elite soldiers of a [[Fel Empire|new Empire]], formerly known as the Imperial Remnant until [[Jagged Fel]]'s ascension as [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]]. At some point after Fel claimed the long-vacant Imperial throne, the Stormtrooper Corps was absorbed into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], though individual stormtrooper units remained active and independent of regular soldiers. The stormtrooper ranks were still dominated by Human recruits by that time, but were also composed of even more enlisted aliens than ever before.<ref name="SWLegacy0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], which had been created by the Empire of the Hand after the dissolution of the original 501st,<ref name="SQ" /> remained active and was stationed on the heavily-fortified world of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Legacy 3" />

In the same year, the Empire's victory over the Galactic Alliance in the [[Sith–Imperial War]] saw the stormtroopers' restoration to prominence as the greatest military force in the galaxy. In addition to fighting once more for galactic conquest, the stormtroopers found themselves in league with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] once again; [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], grandson of Jagged Fel, reluctantly accepted the aid of a new [[One Sith|Sith Order]] when the war first [[127 ABY|began]].<ref name="SWLegacy0" /> In the aftermath of the Alliance's collapse, stormtroopers fought alongside the Empire's Sith allies during the [[Massacre at Ossus|Massacre of]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] where they fought against the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in a bloody and costly battle. Although the stormtroopers and the Sith both suffered their fair share of casualties in a direct attack on the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]], the Jedi were ultimately overwhelmed by the enemy's numbers; the survivors had no choice other than to retreat and escape into hiding as a [[Third Jedi Purge|third purge]] of their Order began in earnest.<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref>

[[File:Fel_Bastion.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Stormtroopers of the 501st swear loyalty to Roan Fel.]]
Ironically, the Empire's conquest of the former Galactic Alliance and its return to galactic-wide dominance, thanks in part to the fighting prowess of the elite Imperial stormtroopers, was a short-lived return to glory. [[137 ABY|Seven years]] after the Sith Lord [[Darth Krayt]] usurped the Imperial throne, Emperor Roan Fel resurfaced and captured Bastion by relying solely on the devotion of [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial loyalists]].<ref name="Legacy 3" /> Among his strongest supporters in the military were the stormtroopers of the 501st Legion and the [[908th Stormtrooper Division]];<ref name="Legacy 4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref> many other units continued to desert [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] as the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] escalated. With two Imperial sovereigns fighting each other for the throne, the galaxy was engulfed in turmoil as stormtrooper units were forced to take sides between the sitting regnant Darth Krayt and the deposed emperor Roan Fel.<ref name="Legacy 3" />

[[File:SecondBattleBorosk-LegacyWar2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers loyal to Emperor Fel battling Sith forces on Borosk.]]
The second civil war had much of the same effects on the Empire as the first one; a wasted expenditure of vital resources, mass devastation on thousands of worlds and a high cost in manpower to the stormtroopers that were forced to fight each other. By the time of the civil war's end, the Empire was a wasted force on both sides. Although Fel's faction emerged victorious over the Sith faction with the assistance of the Jedi Order and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], Roan Fel died during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|final battle]]. No longer in a position to rule the galaxy by the brute force of stormtroopers, the Empire was forced to consolidate its union with the Jedi and the Alliance. Hence, although they ultimately failed to restore the Galactic Empire, the stormtroopers' sacrifices contributed to the formation of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], an organization that was created to rule over the unified galaxy. The stormtroopers' first regnant Empress, [[Marasiah Fel]], represented the Empire as one of the three triumvirs alongside [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the Galactic Alliance and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Legacy-War6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>

==Recruitment==
{{Quote|Aren't you a little short for a stormtrooper?|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], disguised as a stormtrooper, during their escape from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]|audio=ALittleShort.flac|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:AnsonTrask.jpg|thumb|200px|left|[[Anson Trask]], enlisted trooper, fresh out of training.]]
After the failed uprising on Kamino in 12 BBY, Emperor Palpatine came to the conclusion that an army of clone soldiers was far too susceptible to corruption. Thus, he expanded the Stormtrooper Corps to include clones that were created from a variety of genetic templates, effectively marginalizing Jango Fett's progeny into a minority status.<ref name="BF2" /> In addition to the massive influx of new clone sources, the Corps began recruiting non-clone Human beings to serve in the ranks as enlisted stormtroopers.<ref name="TFUIIvg" />

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was seemingly familiar with Stormtrooper Corps's standards by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], perhaps as a result of her work with the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="ANH" /> Human males made up the majority of the recruits due to strictly precise requirements in physique and measurements, though females served as well. Certain [[Near-Human]]s were also eligible for recruitment in some cases.

For a time, the Stormtrooper Corps remained evenly balanced between clones and recruits, at least until the onset of the Imperial Civil War, which occurred alongside the ongoing Galactic Civil War. Due to the loss of Kamino and its cloning facilities, as well as many other cloning centers throughout the galaxy, clone stormtroopers became a rare commodity that the Empire could no longer afford to sustain.<ref name="atlas" /> As the Galactic Empire's unity became undermined by various splinter cell factions, a few successor states opted to vastly reform the Imperial recruiting policy. Unlike the old Empire, the Empire of the Hand recruited stormtroopers from a variety of [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] sources. Though the stormtrooper ranks remained consistently dominated by Human male recruits, it marked the first time that Non-Humans were allowed to serve as Imperial soldiers.<ref name="SQ" />

[[File:Fel_Empire_Troops.jpg|thumb|200px|right|Under the Fel Empire, stormtroopers of various species were intergrated into the wider Imperial Army.]]
The new practice of recruiting Non-Humans as stormtroopers was continued by the Imperial Remnant. Over a century after the fall of the old Empire, the Remnant eventually reformed itself into a [[Fel Empire|new Empire]] that was protected by stormtroopers composed of Humans, [[Near-Human]]s, Humanoids and even Aliens that hardly even resembled the Human anatomy standards. Non-Human stormtroopers were not the only new additions to the Empire's resurgent army, however; Human females became more common within the stormtrooper ranks by 130 ABY.<ref name="SWLegacy0" />

Humans throughout the Empire chose to enlist in the Stormtrooper Corps for a variety of reasons. Many saw service as an opportunity for adventure.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire: To the Last Man">''[[Star Wars: Empire: To the Last Man]]''</ref> Poor citizens were eager for any opportunity to escape poverty or squalid living conditions. Some just wanted a ticket off their home worlds.<ref name="Solo: A Star Wars Story">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Others were attracted by the idea of being part of something bigger and stronger than themselves. Whatever their reasons for joining, all troopers were conditioned to be absolutely loyal to their emperor with little to no regard for their own lives or those of their comrades. However, after being compelled to participate in the Empire's atrocities, even this harsh indoctrination could waver. It was not unheard of for the soldiers to desert. Some even reportedly joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]].<ref name="Trooper comic">{{Tales|10|Trooper (comic story)}}</ref>  

At some point in the Fel-controlled Empire's history, the Imperial Army adopted a relatively new tradition of recruiting the sons and daughters born "in the camp." All children born to stormtroopers, either during or after service, were encouraged to enlist in the army, making soldiering an hereditary career. Since they were not legally forced to follow in their parents' example, an incentive was added to the unofficial policy through the [[Continuity of service|Continuity of Service]], which allowed new troopers to serve in the same unit as their parents.<ref name="Legacy 4" />

[[File:Femtroopers-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Female stormtroopers suit up for patrol]]
Another recruiting tool that the Empire utilized was the [[Imperial Mission]].<ref name="Legacy 4" /> As part of [[High Moff|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] Jagged Fel's [[Victory Without War|strategy]] to alter the common view of the Empire as an oppressive, war-mongering force, the Mission was created to spread Imperial influence through peaceful methods, such as providing aid to worlds that were ravaged by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Invincible" /><ref name="Legacy2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref> However, the Mission also served as a pool of potential recruits. Whether they were grateful for Imperial assistance, or simply had nothing better to do, those who were eligible for service could become enlisted troopers through the Mission. [[Jes Gistang]], a [[Corellian/Legends|native]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], became a stormtrooper through the Imperial Mission. As far as Gistang was concerned, the life of a soldier was better than remaining on her homeworld or any of the other alternative paths that she could have taken.<ref name="Legacy 4" />

By the time of the Second Imperial Civil War, well over a century since the fall of the original Empire, the vast majority of stormtroopers were composed primarily of enlisted soldiers, drawn from a recruiting pool of Humans and Non-Humans alike. No clones of the Fett template or other sources were known to have been in the Imperial service by such time, presumably indicating that the use of clone stormtroopers had been phased out in [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] and the [[Empire-in-exile|Fel faction]].<ref name="SWLegacy0" />

==Organization==
{{Quote|After that, we fought and moved and spoke and thought like stormtroopers - male and female had been taken out of the equation along with everything else.|[[Isila Drutch]] (TD-4388)|<ref name="EGW" />}}
{{Main|Stormtrooper Corps/Legends}}

[[File:Jokers.jpg|thumb|200px|A non-commissioned officer sporting clone trooper-style color insignia in 137 ABY.]]
Although stormtroopers often worked alongside the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] operated independently of all branches of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Hence, the Corps possessed its own command structure, ranking system and support facilities. Together with the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]], stormtroopers answered directly to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers">{{DB|organization|stormtroopers|stormtroopers}}</ref> but were managed on a daily basis by [[Stormtrooper Command/Legends|Stormtrooper Command]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>

The basic unit of organization was the individual [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]. Each stormtrooper was assigned a designation for tactical purposes and to reinforce the Imperial ethic of uniformity. Troopers were organized into [[Squad/Legends|squads]], [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], [[Company/Legends|companies]], [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] and [[Legion/Legends|legions]]. A company commander could give command to regular officers over any given squad or platoon. When it was first formed during the rise of the Galactic Empire, stormtrooper squads had 8 troopers, including a sergeant and a corporal, platoons had 32 troopers (four squads) and were led by a lieutenant and a sergeant-major, companies usually encompassed 128 troopers (four platoons) and were led by a captain, a battalion encompassed 512 troopers (four companies) and were led by a major, a regiment was composed of 2,048 troopers (four battalions) and were led by a lieutenant colonel, and a legion possessed 8,192 troopers (four regiments) led by a high colonel.<ref name="EGW" /> At the height of the Galactic Empire, a single battalion consisted of 820 soldiers,<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" /> whereas a battalion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in comparison comprised only 576 [[Cloning/Legends|clones]].<ref name="GrandArmyGuide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

As of [[130 ABY]], the Stormtrooper Corps was apparently disbanded under the [[Fel Empire]], as well as its successor state, the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The stormtroopers themselves were absorbed into the hierarchy of the Imperial Army. However, individual stormtrooper [[unit]]s continued to exist as elite shock forces in both Krayt's Empire and the [[Roan Fel|Fel]] [[Empire-in-exile|faction]].<ref name="SWLegacy0" /><ref name="Legacy 4" />

===Officers===
[[File:501st_stormtrooper.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A stormtrooper commander, "descendant" of the Republic ARC trooper.]]
Stormtrooper officers were traditionally non-clone graduates from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], but Imperial stormtroopers who demonstrated skills in leadership could be promoted to officer status. In battle, commissioned stormtrooper officers wore standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] with rank insignia to indicate status. Non-commissioned officers were identified in the field with shoulder pauldrons instead of the standard rank squares worn over the armor. For non-combat situations, officers wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|dress uniform]], including a cap, boots, gloves and standard rank squares. Becoming an officer in the Stormtrooper Corps was a stepping stone to joining the more prestigious ranks of the of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]; stormtrooper officers were still hierarchically bound to obey orders from Imperial officers.<ref name="ANH" />

The [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commanders]] were separate from the regular officers in the Stormtrooper Corps. Highly skilled in combat and leadership, the commanders were modeled after the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]], elite clone troopers that fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. As a result, they were widely regarded as superior soldiers to the more common Imperial stormtroopers. Because of their special status, the commanders were entrusted with command over the Empire's [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] and were given authority to utilize them at their own discretion without requiring any clearance from [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]]. As an anomaly within an organization that stressed absolute uniformity, the stormtrooper commanders were easily noticeable due to the [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings on their armor, which otherwise perfectly resembled stormtrooper armor. However, unlike the protective suits worn by normal troopers, the commanders wore a specialized variant that was equipped with a built-in [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield generator]] which was impervious to many attacks, including certain [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|offensive techniques]], but was highly vulnerable to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|strikes]].<ref name="Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' in-game databank</ref>

Due to the accelerated aging process of the Kamino-bred clones and the redirecting of the Imperial cloning program, real Human beings gradually superseded clone officers as the majority within the command structure of the Stormtrooper Corps. In the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], almost twenty years after the [[19 BBY/Legends|formation]] of the Galactic Empire, there was only a small minority of clone officers that remained active ever since the conclusion of the Clone Wars; [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] was among the few clone veterans that continued to serve in the military. Due to the decline in the creation of clone soldiers and the growing preference for recruiting manpower, Cody found himself in command of a unit composed mainly of enlisted troopers, much to his dissatisfaction.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" />

By [[137 ABY]], the Imperial Army utilized a color-ranking system for officers in charge of stormtrooper units. This system mirrored the one that was utilized within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], prior to the point when color came to denote unit affiliation rather than rank. [[Ran Harkas]]' armor was distinguished with olive green markings, thus visually confirming his rank as [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] within the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]]'s [[Joker Squad]].<ref name="Legacy 4" />

==Ideology==
{{Quote|Stormtrooper ideology is terrifying in its thoroughness. They can't be reasoned with, which means they can't be deprogrammed.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], commenting in ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Palpatine.jpg|thumb|230px|right|Stormtroopers of the first Galactic Empire were indoctrinated with absolute loyalty to Emperor Palpatine.]]
In addition to their role as elite military soldiers of the Galactic Empire, the Imperial stormtroopers were the most visible symbol of Emperor Palpatine's rule and the unrivaled might of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial war machine]]. They were the highly trained shock troopers that were unwaveringly dedicated to enforcing Imperial power through fear and brutality on countless worlds spread throughout the galaxy. Whether on the ground or in space, their purpose was to attack with speed, accuracy and overwhelming numbers whenever faced with an insurrection against the Empire.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" />

Loyalty, obedience and the readiness to [[Death/Legends|die]] for Emperor Palpatine were the primary traits that were indoctrinated into all stormtroopers. In their capacity as enforcers of the Empire, stormtroopers were also trained to completely support and uphold the ideals of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Every individual trooper was fully expected to obey their superior officers without question or hesitance, regardless if they were required to unleash harm on others or even place themselves in extreme danger. As a result of their militaristic and highly disciplined nature, stormtroopers were well aware of their expendable status to the Emperor&mdash;and they were ready to lay down their lives to ensure the continuance of his reign and the Empire.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" /> As such, this ideology, training, and discipline prevented them from getting distracted by emotional responses, to the extent of even ignoring casualties within their own ranks during combat situations, the only times casualties on their end is taken notice is from a tactical standpoint.<ref name="Complete Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Their ideology was such that they cannot be bribed or blackmailed, and is unswerving in obedience and unflinching in dispensing Imperial justice, and even went as far to state that their armor, helmet, and number is their skin, face, and name, respectively.

The extent of such conditioning was such that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] even admitted that such indoctrination was terrifying especially regarding its thoroughness, and it was virtually impossible to sway stormtroopers away from their orders due to them being nearly impossible to be negotiated with.<ref name="Handbook" /> Despite their intense indoctrination, enlisted stormtroopers were still capable of living civilian lives; they received pay, were given periods of leave time, and under some circumstances were given opportunities to retire from service.

[[File:Clones-SWPurge.jpg|thumb|230px|left|Clone stormtroopers enforced the Empire's authority with unquestioning loyalty due to their genetically modified personalities.]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] were genetically modified to suppress their individuality with unquestioning loyalty;<ref name="BF2" /> enlisted stormtroopers were rigorously trained to abandon their individual identities by embracing said loyalty to the Emperor.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" /> Their allegiance to Palpatine required the stormtroopers to impose his authority on both civilians and non-stormtrooper military personnel, especially with regard to the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Upon the completion of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], an army of stormtroopers was stationed on the battle station. In addition to the presence of the Emperor's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the stormtroopers were a major deterrent against ambitious officers who contemplated turning the power of the Death Star against Palpatine.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

The loyalty that stormtroopers possessed was so complete that they could be neither bribed, seduced or blackmailed to abandon their allegiance to the Empire or its sovereign.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" /> However, the deaths of Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] began a chain of events that nearly saw the complete destruction of the Galactic Empire and the stormtroopers that enforced its ideology.<ref name="ROTJ" /> By the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the former Empire had been diminished into a small state known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]; stormtroopers became an increasingly rare sight after their numbers were vastly depleted over years of attrition and warfare.<ref name="SpecterPast" />

Yet even with the loss of both Sith Lords and the virtual collapse of the Galactic Empire, stormtroopers ultimately proved to be one of the few enduring legacies of Emperor Palpatine and the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. The Imperial Remnant and the [[Empire of the Hand]], both of which were successor states to the former Empire, both attempted to preserve the tenets of the New Order, particularly by maintaining stormtroopers in their respective military forces. Although reduced to a pale shadow of their former glory, the continued use of stormtroopers ensured that they would not follow Palpatine and Vader into oblivion.<ref name="SQ" /><ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:XR-85_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|220px|right|Following Palpatine's death, Stormtroopers of various Imperial warlords would often combat each other throughout the Imperial Civil War.]]
The death of Palpatine, as well as many officials who supported the New Order in its original form, allowed both the Remnant and the Hand to introduce various reforms to ensure the overall continuation of Imperial ideology. Without the many cloning facilities that supplied the Empire with half of its stormtroopers, the Remnant and the Hand became desperately reliant on recruitment to reinforce their weakened manpower. Without a vast pool of civilians to recruit, both states were forced to radically alter certain Imperial ideals in order to recruit [[Non-huMan|Non-Human]] individuals as well as significantly more [[Gender/Legends|females]].<ref name="SQ" /> This was a desperate measure in response to the desperate situation. As the triumphant [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] consolidated its rule over the galaxy, first as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and then as the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Imperial Remnant could no longer rely on just [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to fill the ranks of the stormtroopers. As a consequence, the system of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] was greatly reduced over time.<ref name="CSWE" /> However, although not as prevalent as males, there have been female stormtroopers within the first Galactic Empire. A particularly notable example of this was [[Isila Drutch]] of the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]]. According to Drutch in her memoirs, the reason there were few female members had very little to do with any prejudice against females, as she noted that there weren't any female genetic templates, and that the stormtrooper physical regimen was brutal enough that females were simply more likely to wash out more than males. Drutch also implied the possibility that the design of the Stormtrooper armor was such that it was likely assumed there were very few females among the Stormtroopers.<ref name="EGW" /> By [[130 ABY]], the resurgent [[Fel Empire|Empire]], the successor state of the Remnant, maintained a vast army of stormtroopers recruited from both Human males and females, as well as various [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWLegacy0" />

[[File:Yinchorrilegacy31.jpg|thumb|left|230px|A reformed version of Imperial ideology allowed aliens and females to enlist as stormtroopers long after Palpatine's death.]]
Under the [[Fel dynasty|Fel-ruled]] Empire, military service as a stormtrooper was regarded by civilians and soldiers alike as a mark of pride. The Empire took great strides to promote enlistment through channels such as the Imperial Mission or enticements like the Continuity of Service.<ref name="Legacy 4" /> After the [[One Sith]] established their control over the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Galactic Empire]], stormtroopers became enforcers of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rule once more and were often directed to carry out their duties by spreading fear and terror amongst the galactic populace. Though much remained the same in terms of the recruitment policy, the stormtroopers of this [[Legacy era|era]] were just as capable of excessive brutality and genocide as their predecessors who served under Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>

Even after they were forced to take sides between [[Darth Krayt]]'s Empire and the Imperial loyalists who supported the deposed emperor [[Roan Fel]], the stormtroopers as a whole remained as one of the most persevering symbols of Imperial ideology as envisioned by Palpatine and Sith philosophy.<ref name="Legacy 4" /> For [[138 ABY|nearly two centuries]] since the rise of the original Galactic Empire, stormtroopers were both respected and feared as the greatest military force in [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]]. Throughout their existence, stormtroopers were a testament to the might of the Galactic Empire, in all of its forms, the enduring legacy of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] greatest creation, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and ultimately a symbol of the Imperial way of providing order and peace through force of arms.<ref name="Legacy2" /><ref name="Legacy-War6" />

==Equipment==
===Weaponry===
{{Quote|Only Imperial stormtroopers are so precise.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:E-11_btm.jpg|thumb|200px|right|A stormtrooper wielding an E-11 blaster rifle]]
The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] was the standard issue weapon of the Stormtrooper Corps and one of the most commonly issued rifles in the Imperial Military. The E-11 blaster rifle was largely based on the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster rifle, the standard weapon of the clone troopers during the Clone Wars, right down to the folding stock.<ref name="JK2JO" /> With the exception of troopers assigned to roles that involved heavy or special weapons, the rank-and-file stormtroopers carried an E-11 along with a [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blaster]].<ref name="BF1">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> They also had access to modified [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

In addition to their standard weapons, some elite stormtroopers were armed with the deadly [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]]. Though not as common as the E-11, the DLT-19 was more powerful and accurate. Other weapons in the stormtrooper arsenal included: [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] "Caspel" projectile launcher, [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifle]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> "[[Equalizer]]" shoulder-fired ion cannon, [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine|DEMP gun]], [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]],<ref name="Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]], [[DXR6 heavy carbine]], [[PLX-4 Missile Launcher]], [[Ion mortar]], [[Imperial Heavy Repeater|Imperial heavy repeater]],<ref name="JK2JO" /> [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher|PLX-2M]] "Plex" missile tubes, [[Stouker concussion rifle]], [[Proton rifle/Legends|Proton rifle]], [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifle]], [[4-X blaster rifle]], [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]],<ref name="ANH" /> and the [[T-28 repeating sniper rifle]]<ref name="Allegiance" /> They could also use [[LX-4 proton mine/Legends|LX-4 self-detonating perimeter mines]] or [[LXR-6 concussion grenade/Legends|LXR-6 concussion grenades]].<ref name="BF1" />

[[File:Soldier_stub.png|thumb|left|190px|A stormtrooper armed with an SE-14r light repeating blaster]]
All stormtroopers possessed a [[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator|Baradium-core code key]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] attached to the back of their torso armor. The thermal detonators were specially designed to ensure that only the stormtroopers themselves could utilize them, thus ensuring that Rebel troopers could not use the Imperials' own explosives against them. The security measures for the stormtroopers' thermal detonators included an arming code. To further prevent the explosives from being used by enemy combatants, the buttons on the thermal detonator were unlabeled. Each thermal detonator arming code was unique, known only to the soldier to whom the device was issued.<ref name="Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

By the year [[130 ABY]], during the era of the [[Fel Empire|resurgent Empire]], stormtroopers were issued a new standard weapon: the [[ARC-9965 blaster rifle]]. Although it was more energy dependent than its distant predecessor, the ARC-9965 model was built for superior accuracy. Although the E-11 blaster rifle had been virtually obsolete and superseded by new designs, it was still utilized as a military weapon alongside the ARC-9965 blaster rifle.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

===Armor===
{{Main|Stormtrooper armor/Legends}}
{{Quote|I'm takin' you down, plastic boy!|Anonymous Rebel trooper|<ref name="BF2" />}}
[[File:Stormtrooper-CotF.jpg|thumb|left|A stormtrooper in full armor]]
Prior to the development and distribution of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], the first Imperial stormtroopers wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II battle armor]] during various assignments, such as the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Cleansing]] of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]<ref name="Into the Unknown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown]]''</ref> and the search for [[Garoche Tarkin]].<ref name="Lost Command">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Lost Command]]''</ref> However, by the time Naboo was subjugated by military force in 18 BBY, the old Phase II battle armor had become obsolete and replaced by a new suit of Imperial armor.<ref name="BF2" />

Even before the creation of stormtrooper armor, the Empire's clone soldiers were required to remove the unit affiliation markings that adorned their Phase II armor.<ref name="Dark Times 15">[[Dark Times 15|''Dark Times'' 15]]</ref> From then on, virtually all stormtroopers were identified by their distinctive [[Color/Legends|white]] armor.<ref name="EncyclopediaStormtroopers">{{SWE|groups|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}}</ref> This tradition of military uniformity carried on for over a century into Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. However, stormtroopers of rank, such as non-commissioned officers, were identified as separate from the rank-and-file troopers through the color stripes on their armor.<ref name="Legacy 4" />
[[File:StormtroopersBlasted_TESB30.jpg|thumb|right|Stormtrooper armor was notoriously poor at protecting its wearer.]]
The stormtrooper armor was 18 pieces of white [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]]-composite body armor over a sealed [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]]. The complete ensemble encased the wearer's body. As the stormtroopers were an evolution of the clone troopers, so too was their armor inspired by its Phase II precursor from the Clone Wars. In addition to its imposing appearance, the armor provided a wide range of survival equipment and temperature controls to allow the stormtroopers to survive in almost any environment.<ref name="EncyclopediaStormtroopers" />

Aside from harsh environments, the armor also protected the troopers from projectiles and impact weapons. Although it could be penetrated by a direct blaster bolt, the armor was capable of reducing the damage from the absorbed bolt. Blast energy sinks were distributed around the armor to absorb energy from a blaster bolt. The insulated body glove allowed for comfortable operations in an very wide range of climates, including&mdash;for a very short time&mdash;even total vacuum conditions, or immense extremes of cold and heat.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" />
[[File:BF_Mustafar_6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Stormtroopers dawning various armor sets combating a Separatist holdout on Mustafar.]]
Specialized stormtroopers, known as "armored stormtroopers," also wore a heavier version of the stormtrooper armor. The armor in question was detailed with various lines.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

In some cases, Stormtrooper officers who are undergoing combat situations leading various Stormtroopers wore colored shoulder pauldrons as high-visibility rank indicators.<ref name="Complete Dictionary" /> In addition, they also sometimes wore a variation of Stormtrooper armor that possessed colored lines around the chest, arms, shoulders, and the right side of their helmet and face, to indicate their unit.<ref name="Handbook" />

By 130 ABY, many variants of stormtrooper armor were created for [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] enlisted troopers who served in the Imperial Army. The general appearance of the armor had only minor changes, however. Other than a few cosmetic alterations, the armor was reportedly designed to better protect soldiers from blaster fire, thus reducing the risk of sustaining severe or fatal injuries.<ref name="SWLegacy0" />

===Officer's Uniform===
{{Main|Imperial officer's uniform/Legends}}

[[File:CommanderPraji.png|thumb|right|200px|Commander Praji, an officer of the Stormtrooper Corps in uniform.]]
When in non-combat situations, various Stormtrooper officers wear a uniform similar to various other officers in the Imperial military hierarchy, and specifically conformed to the uniform standards of the Imperial Navy branch. The uniform worn by a Stormtrooper officer was identified as being black-colored tunics and caps. Because the uniform was largely derived from similar uniform standards of the Imperial Navy, the Stormtrooper officer uniform featured several similar insignia, including [[Officer's disk/Legends|officer's discs]], [[rank insignia]] plaques, and [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]], the last of which allowed Stormtrooper officers access to secure areas and computer systems.<ref name="Complete Dictionary" />

===Extra===
Some special features include a wrist [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a small battle [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] built into the helmet, a proper [[resonator]] (to open secure doors) built into their armor, and an external helmet light. For extended operations, stormtroopers carried field backpacks that included a personal tent, five concentrated rations, fifteen water packs, eight blaster [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]], and a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]]. They also used [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] as support weapons.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" /> The utility belt on their armor included a small attachment which could be clipped onto with an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], thus freeing both of the trooper's arms.<ref name="ANH" /> Stormtroopers wore a white-on-white ID tag on the left shoulder, invisible to the naked eye, even at close range, but could be seen by other stormtroopers through their visor's visual enhancements.<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

==Specialized stormtroopers==
{{Quote|The Empire's army is infinite.|A drunk [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] to [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Storm1-vd.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Standard stormtrooper]]
There were several subgroups in the Stormtrooper Corps with training and equipment for particular mission profiles, generally sorted by the type of environment the trooper would encounter. Recruits to the Stormtrooper Corps are selected for specialization at an early stage of training, and thus are conditioned with the appropriate knowledge and psychological training for the tasks required of them. As a result, their psychological conditioning to their particular identity once specialized is so strong that the resulting specialized stormtrooper almost never wishes to change his division.
*[[Aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers trained for aquatic combat.<ref name="Star Wars 74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref>
*[[Armored Stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers equipped with heavier armor and weapons.<ref name="SW:GB" />
*[[Assault trooper]]s: Stormtroopers who wore standard white armor with yellow markings.<ref name="SW Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
*[[Bomb squad stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers trained in bomb disposal.<ref name="Star Wars 56">[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]]</ref>
*[[Cavetrooper]]s: A variant of stormtroopers who were trained to operate in various geographical areas. They used a lighter version of armor, similar to that of scout troopers and carried blaster carbines.<ref name="Cavetroopers">{{FFG|story=Hidden Depths|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Game Master's Kit|text=''Force and Destiny'': Game Master's Kit}}</ref>
*[[Clone stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers cloned from a variety of genetic templates.<ref name="BF2" />
*[[Cold assault stormtrooper]]s: Also known as snowtroopers; stormtroopers equipped with specialized armor suited to cold terrain environments.<ref name="ESB" />
*[[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]: A police force of elite stormtroopers tasked with patrolling Coruscant.
*[[Crowd Control Stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers equipped and trained for combating civilian uprisings.<ref name="Power of the Force">[[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'' toy line (1995)]]</ref>
*[[Cuis clone]]s: [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] stormtroopers cloned from the genetic template of [[Sa Cuis]]; trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and basic [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]].<ref name="A Two-Edged Sword">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>
*[[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]]: Special droid/exoskeleton stormtroopers.<ref name="TESGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
**[[Dark Trooper Project]]: An Imperial program designed to create an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] stormtroopers.<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>
***[[Phase Zero dark trooper]]s: Aged [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], transformed into cyborgs.<ref name="BF1" />
***[[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I dark troopers]]: Dark troopers armed with [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] and blast shields.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
***[[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II dark troopers]]: Dark troopers armed with [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannons]], Imperial repeater rifles, and equipped with jetpacks.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
***[[Phase III Dark Trooper|Phase III dark troopers]]: Dark troopers armed with assault cannons and Seeker missiles, occasionally a pair of dual blaster cannons, with two per wrist, as well as six PLEX rocket tubes, with three per shoulder, and jetpacks.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
**[[Triumphant-class dark trooper]]: Dark troopers created as a hybrid between battle droids and stormtroopers.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
**[[Black Hole dark trooper]]s: Dark troopers deployed with [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtroopers]].<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
**[[Exogen-class dark trooper]]: A dark trooper variant used by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
**[[Dark Novatrooper|Dark novatrooper]]: Dark trooper variant, programmed with expertise in boarding operations.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
**[[Glory-class dark trooper]]: Dark trooper variant, primarily used as [[City/Legends|city]] guards.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
**[[Inquisitorium dark trooper]]s: Dark trooper variant, created to serve under the direct command of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="Trials of Obi-Wan">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
**[[Purge trooper]]: Dark trooper prototype specialized for anti-Jedi combat.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Dewback trooper/Legends|Dewback trooper]]: Sandtroopers mounted on [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]], used as a light cavalry force.<ref name="ANH" />
*[[Stormtrooper droid]]: Droids manufactured on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] with stormtrooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88's]] [[IG-88's Droid Army|Droid Army]].<ref name="Therefore I Am">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

[[File:DarkNovatrooper.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Dark novatrooper]]
*[[EVO trooper]]s: Stormtroopers armed and trained to operate within the most hazardous environments.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Field stormtrooper]]s: High-ranking stormtroopers with superior field experience and weaponry.<ref name="Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>
*[[Hazard stormtrooper]]s: Cyborg Stormtroopers equipped with armor that was impervious to extreme temperatures, acidic damage and small-arms fire.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />
*[[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Heavy troopers]]: Stormtroopers trained in close-range combat, armed with an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] for melee combat.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]]: Stormtroopers trained for boarding operations.<ref name="BF2" />
*[[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|Incinerator stormtroopers]]: Stormtroopers equipped with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], composed of pyromaniac clones raised to live with an intense urge to burn and destroy.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Imperial Elite Guard]]: An elite honor guard tasked with protecting the leading government officials of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], such as the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] and the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="Revelation" />
*[[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]]: Stormtroopers trained for airborne combat.<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
*[[Imperial Navy commando]]s: Light-armored stormtroopers used by the Imperial Navy.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends#ISB stormtroopers|ISB Stormtroopers]]: Stormtroopers under the direct command of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], sometimes used as spies within the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="Allegiance" />
*[[Magma stormtrooper]]s: Stormtroopers trained to operate within volcanic environments, such as [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" />
*[[Minetrooper]]s: [[Sevarcos II]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mine security troopers.<ref name="Adventure Journal 2">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>
*[[Novatrooper]]s: Stormtrooper honor guards, equipped with distinctive black and gold armor, used as [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] for special assignments.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
*[[Radiation zone assault trooper]]s: An elite stormtrooper variant, equipped to operate in deadly radiation-filled environments.<ref name="SWDB_stormtroopers" />
*[[Riot stormtrooper/Legends|Riot stormtroopers]]: Stormtroopers who specialized in combating insurrectionists and uprisings.<ref name="TFUIIvg" />
*[[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtroopers]]: Stormtroopers who operated in desert terrain environments, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" />
*[[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]]: Light-armored stormtrooper variants, trained as reconnaissance troopers, spies and survivalists.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Scouttrooper_btm.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Scout trooper]]
*[[Shadow EVO Trooper]]s: A variant of both [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtroopers]] and [[EVO trooper]]s.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*[[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow stormtroopers]]: Stormtroopers who specialized in stealth operations, equipped with black armor and [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] for camouflage purposes;<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> also known as "Blackhole stormtroopers" because of their service under Agent [[Cronal|Blackhole]].<ref name="Gambler's World">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref>
*[[Shadowtrooper]]s ([[Empire Reborn]]): [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] stormtroopers trained in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="JK2JO" />
*[[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Shock troopers]]: Elite stormtroopers equipped and trained as heavy weapons specialists,<ref name="BF2" /> later served in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] as soldiers of the [[Imperial Elite Guard]].<ref name="Revelation" />
*Stormtrooper recruits: Freshly-inducted members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. They had weaker [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and minimal experience in combat. Because of this, they were very rarely used in direct combat.<ref name="SW:GB" />
*[[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]]: An elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit that operated within the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
*[[Stormrifle]]s: Specialized soldiers of the Stormtrooper Corps, equipped with yellow command pauldrons.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
*[[Stormtrooper sniper/Legends|Stormsnipers]]: Specialized soldiers of the Stormtrooper Corps, equipped with white command pauldrons.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />

[[File:Swamp_trooper_SWG_Galactic_hunters_by_Shoemaker.jpg|thumb|150px|Swamptrooper]]
*[[Wetland assault stormtrooper]]s: Nicknamed swamptroopers; a variant unit of scout troopers that operated in marshy environments.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />
*[[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]: Stormtroopers equipped and trained to operate in outer space.<ref name="Scoundrel's Luck">''[[Scoundrel's Luck]]''</ref>

Occasionally, rank-and-file stormtroopers could serve as TIE fighter pilots, as was the case of an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Unidentified Alderaanian stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who shot down [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]].<ref name="Star Wars 86">[[Star Wars (1977) 86|''Star Wars'' (1977) 86]]</ref>

===Alien stormtroopers===
{{Quote|The stormtroopers of the 501st consist of humans and nonhumans. ''[&hellip;]'' Including a number of your own people.|Grand Admiral Thrawn to [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
[[File:Fel_Empire_Troops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] stormtrooper of the Fel Empire alongside human soldiers.]]
Stormtroopers were one of the bases of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] during Palpatine's reign, and thus their ranks were exclusively reserved for Human clones and recruits. An exception to this policy were the T'Syriél stormtroopers, Imperial soldiers recruited from among the alien [[T'Syriél]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar|Sk'ar]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 54">[[Star Wars (1977) 54|''Star Wars'' (1977) 54]]</ref> Sk'ar himself was an alien [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], which explains why he was prepared to deviate from standard Imperial recruitment policy. Later, there was a small corps of alien stormtroopers serving under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] in the [[United Warlord Fleets]] until her resignation.<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> Alien stormtroopers were more common in the Empire of the Hand<ref name="SQ" /> and Roan Fel's Empire some 130 years [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="SWLegacy0" />

===ISB Stormtroopers===
{{Main|Imperial Security Bureau/Legends}}
The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] had its own stormtroopers that operated outside the command structure of the Stormtrooper Corps. As they were identical to regular stormtroopers in [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|appearance]], they were occasionally used to infiltrate standard units of stormtroopers to ensure that assigned tasks were properly accomplished. A good example of this practice was an [[Teardrop massacre|attack]] against Rebel sympathizers on [[Teardrop]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. ISB stormtroopers noticed that [[Daric LaRone]], an enlisted trooper, was deliberately not shooting civilians.<ref name="Allegiance" />

ISB stormtroopers were also more questioning of their orders than standard stormtroopers. Two ISB troopers betrayed the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] while she was infiltrating a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base on [[Gepparin]]. Aside from infiltrating regular military units, they were often attached to ISB [[tactical unit]]s.<ref name="Allegiance" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ST_Lightsaber.png|thumb|250px|Concept art of stormtroopers.]]
Stormtroopers, as depicted in the early drafts of ''Star Wars'' and envisioned by [[Ralph McQuarrie]], were to wield lightsabers and hand-held shields.
[[George Lucas]], when composing background information for licensees in [[1977]], stated that females did exist in the Stormtrooper Corps, although there were few stationed on the Death Star. He suggested that they were numerous in other units.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> As a result, few female stormtroopers are explicitly depicted in [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources.

According to several Expanded Universe sources, it would appear that by the time of the Galactic Civil War, stormtroopers were no longer exclusively clones. In [[Empire 36|''Empire'' 36]], following the Imperial [[Subjugation of Jabiim|assault]] on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]] checks his surviving troops. At this point he comments that none of the regular Human troops under his command survived the battle and we are given a look at a group of blue-eyed and blonde clones, obviously a newer template. Sunber also says that the clones in the army are tough and he heard that during the Clone Wars they were even tougher. So, it would seem that with the expansion of the military following the rise of the Galactic Empire, new clone templates were created and regular Humans recruited partly because the lifespan of a Jango clone was roughly half that of an ordinary Human. Thus, a steady stream of clone and non-clone replacements would be required to fill the ranks of the stormtroopers.

The first source to mention that there are clones in the stormtrooper ranks was [[Soldiers of the Empire!]], an article that appeared in ''[[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 4]]'' (January [[1978]]). Unfortunately, this article fell into deep obscurity (most fans still have not heard of it),<ref name="Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 4">[[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 4|''Star Wars Official Poster Monthly'' 4]]</ref> though this aligns with ''[[The Star Wars Compendium 2: The World of Star Wars]]'', the second issue of the ''[[The Star Wars Compendium]]'' series released in [[1981]], which stated that all stormtroopers were cloned human beings.<ref name="The Star Wars Compendium 2: The World of Star Wars">''[[The Star Wars Compendium 2: The World of Star Wars]]''</ref> As a result, most EU authors prior to the prequel trilogy believed that all stormtroopers were recruits. Many Expanded Universe sources mentioned Imperial academies (such as on [[Carida Academy/Legends|Carida]]) and normal human stormtroopers such as [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] and [[Kyle Katarn]]. After the prequel trilogy was released, a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] was necessary to shoe clones into the stormtrooper ranks to mesh these EU sources with the movies and 1978 article.

[[File:Chewie_negtc.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Even armor couldn't protect against an angry Wookiee]]
In the [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''Thrawn Trilogy'']], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] realizes that some of Grand Admiral Thrawn's stormtroopers are clones by feeling through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that they are all identical. He implies that this is unusual.

''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' introduced a new, non-[[canon]] stormtrooper type known as the "[[beach trooper]]." They wore a standard helmet and swimming shorts, and could be found resting in hot tubs throughout some levels.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', enter TK421 as a cheat code to unlock the classic stormtrooper skin.

Due to their seeming "inability" to hit the main characters in the films, and to a lesser extent, the main characters being more likely to hit their targets in desperate situations, the stormtrooper effect (Urban Dictionary definition [http://www.urbandictionary.com/define.php?term=stormtrooper%20effect here]) has been named after them. However, it should be noted that in the case of at least the first two films, it was heavily implied that the stormtroopers were deliberately missing the main characters so they could lure them into a trap (in ''A New Hope'', it was to have Han Solo and Luke Skywalker lure the Death Star to [[Yavin 4/Legends|their hidden Rebel base]], which Leia also implied, and in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', it was to lure the ''Millennium Falcon'' to the ''Executor'').

According to Mary S. Henderson's ''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'', the stormtroopers, and in particular, their armor, were partly inspired by the police droids of the underground prison facility in [[Wikipedia:THX-1138|THX-1138]], one of George Lucas's first films.<ref name="Star Wars: The Magic of Myth book">[[Star Wars: The Magic of Myth (book)|''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'']]</ref>
